boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Pitt spaces for individual work, group sessions, graduate research, and project-based study.

cards.title: Read beneath the Cathedral’s Gothic vaults
cards.subtitle: Cathedral of Learning, ground floor
cards.notes: Set up at a table in the four-story Commons Room for reading or writing; wireless internet is available, and the room is used for study and contemplation.
cards.short_summary: A large historic hall with tables, Wi-Fi, and a clearly documented study function.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt describes the Commons Room as a setting for study and confirms wireless internet is available.
cards.source_title: Cathedral Commons Room | University of Pittsburgh
cards.access_notes: Check Cathedral building access before visiting; Pitt lists public and ID-holder access separately.

cards.title: Book a Hillman room for a focused group session
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library
cards.notes: Reserve with a Pitt email, keep the confirmation available, and plan within the stated six-hours-per-week and 24-hours-per-month booking limits.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for academic group work, with clear booking rules.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillman group study spaces are bookable with a Pitt email; unreserved rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Group Study Space | University of Pittsburgh Library System
cards.access_notes: Reservation required when booked; no food or drink is permitted in these spaces.

cards.title: Use Hillman’s graduate study rooms
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library
cards.notes: If you are a graduate student, confirm eligibility with library staff and use these quiet rooms for sustained degree work rather than informal meetings.
cards.short_summary: Quiet Hillman rooms maintained for graduate students pursuing their programs.
cards.evidence_claim: ULS identifies Graduate Study Rooms in Hillman as quiet spaces for graduate students pursuing their degree programs.
cards.source_title: Public & Access Services at Hillman | University of Pittsburgh Library System
cards.access_notes: Secure access is maintained by Hillman staff; eligibility and access details should be confirmed before use.

cards.entity_name: Hillman Library PhD Dissertation Writing Carrels
cards.title: Apply for a dissertation-writing carrel
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library
cards.notes: Complete the eligibility form with your graduate program director if you have passed comprehensive exams and are taking dissertation credits.
cards.short_summary: Assigned quiet-work carrels for eligible Pitt doctoral candidates.
cards.evidence_claim: Assigned Hillman carrels are available to eligible Pitt PhD candidates working on dissertation research or writing.
cards.source_title: PhD Dissertation Writing Carrels | University of Pittsburgh Library System
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid Pitt ID, qualifying doctoral status, and an approved request; carrels are assigned for an academic year.

cards.title: Work with specialized software in the Digital Scholarship Lab
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library, Room G30
cards.notes: Use the first-come workstations for a digital project, but check the event schedule because workshops can temporarily take the lab offline.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor digital-work space with high-powered computers and specialized software.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Scholarship Lab provides specialized workstations for individual or collaborative digital projects on a first-come basis.
cards.source_title: Digital Scholarship Lab @ Hillman | University of Pittsburgh Library System
cards.access_notes: Available when Hillman is open and no event is taking place; computer access uses Pitt Passport credentials.

cards.title: Prototype a course or research project in Open Lab
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library, Room 132
cards.notes: Complete the relevant short online pre-training, then make an appointment to use the makerspace tools or get hands-on project guidance.
cards.short_summary: A staffed academic makerspace for digital creation and experiential learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Open Lab @ Hillman offers Pitt community members free access and training for making and research tools.
cards.source_title: Open Lab @ Hillman | University of Pittsburgh Library System
cards.access_notes: Pitt students, faculty, and staff are welcome; online pre-training and an appointment are required to get started.

cards.title: Reserve the Text & conText Lab for project work
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library
cards.notes: Use the Library System’s group-reservation route to plan a text-focused digital project, and confirm the room’s current availability before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A publicly bookable Hillman lab for text-centered digital work.
cards.evidence_claim: ULS identifies the Text & conText Lab as a publicly bookable library space and links its group-reservation process.
cards.source_title: Library Space Use Policy | University of Pittsburgh Library System
cards.access_notes: Use the linked group-reservation process; library spaces are reserved for academic-related purposes.

cards.title: Develop a visual assignment in the Film Media Lab
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library, Room G43
cards.notes: Reserve the black-box studio when a research, class, or creative project needs controlled space for photography or film production.
cards.short_summary: A reservable black-box studio for academic media-production projects.
cards.evidence_claim: ULS lists Media Lab: Film in Hillman Room G43 as a black-box studio for media creation, photography, and film production.
cards.source_title: Media Labs | University of Pittsburgh Library System
cards.access_notes: Media Labs are available by reservation to Pitt students, faculty, and staff; the reserving user must pass the Film quiz.

cards.title: Record or mix an academic audio project
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library, Room G44
cards.notes: Reserve this studio when your coursework or research calls for recording and mixing; verify the required Media Lab preparation before scheduling.
cards.short_summary: A reservable Hillman studio designed for high-quality audio work.
cards.evidence_claim: ULS identifies Media Lab: Audio in Hillman Room G44 as a studio for producing, recording, and mixing high-quality audio.
cards.source_title: Media Labs | University of Pittsburgh Library System
cards.access_notes: Available by reservation to Pitt students, faculty, and staff; only the person reserving must complete the Film quiz.

cards.title: Create a presentation in the One Button Studio
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library, Room G45
cards.notes: Book a 30-minute session to record a polished video or audio component for a class, portfolio, or research presentation with minimal setup.
cards.short_summary: A reservable all-in-one room for straightforward video and audio creation.
cards.evidence_claim: ULS describes the One Button Studio as an all-in-one recording room, reservable in 30-minute increments during Hillman operating hours.
cards.source_title: Media Labs | University of Pittsburgh Library System
cards.access_notes: Reserve through Media Services; availability is limited to Hillman Library operating hours.
